title: $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\cO_E)$ is a left adjoint for proper $p$
statement:
Let $E\subseteq\Qlb$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $\cO_E$, let
$\Lambda=\underline{\cO}_E$ ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and let $p\colon Z\to Y$ be a proper
morphism of the setting. Then the derived pushforward
$Rp_*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\underline{\cO}_E)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Y,\underline{\cO}_E)$
of [def-sfb-dc-lower-star] has a right adjoint $Rp^!$.

external.place: On each level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, the étale $Rp^!$ exists (SGA 4, XVIII) and preserves bounded constructible complexes (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*).

The levels are compatible with reduction, and their derived limit is right adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline{\cO}_E)$ (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).

proof.text:
This is the first part of the argument in the proof of
[lem-sfb-dc-proper-pushforward-left-adjoint-e]. On each level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, the étale $Rp^!$
exists (SGA 4, XVIII) and preserves bounded constructible complexes (SGA 4½,
*Th. finitude*). The levels are compatible with reduction, and their derived limit is right
adjoint to $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline{\cO}_E)$ (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
